title: Scratch projects: only folders Maestro created, carrying its marker file, are listed, marked or deletable
summary: Maestro writes a hidden marker into each scratch project it creates; only marked folders are listed, flagged or deletable, and the marker is checked once before the delete retries.

deferred.what: When a process keeps a scratch project's folder busy longer than the retry window (~1.8 s), the first remove deletes the marker with the other files and the delete ends in an error; the project then drops out of the pill and a second Delete answers 'Maestro didn't make that folder…' while the empty folder keeps its name taken.
deferred.why: Fails closed and loses no data; the fix (remove the marker last, or write it back) needs a design choice and its own test.
